clue.text: Sick note written by doctor in Bury

indicators.note: sick here means unwell, out of sorts, so the letters of the next word are disordered

parts.note: MB is Bachelor of Medicine, a doctor's qualification

explanation.surface: A doctor's sick note turns up in the Lancashire town of Bury.
explanation.walkthrough: Bury looks like the Lancashire town, which would tempt a capital letter; here it is the verb. 'Sick' signals the rearrangement.
explanation.definitionFit: To entomb someone is to inter them in a tomb, a straightforward synonym for burial.

clue.text: Leading lady's letter to the papers

parts.note: em is the name of the letter M
the newspapers collectively are the press

explanation.surface: A leading actress writes a letter to the newspapers.
explanation.walkthrough: EM is how the letter M is spelt out; 'to' just joins it to PRESS.
explanation.definitionFit: An empress is a female ruler, a lady who literally leads an empire.

clue.text: See 8
27 time in Rome excited US gang member

indicators.note: excited means stirred up, so the letters are shaken into a new order

parts.note: 27 is summer, and British Summer Time is BST

explanation.surface: Summertime in Rome gets an American gangster worked up.
explanation.walkthrough: 27 across is SUMMER, so '27 time' is BST, British Summer Time; 'excited' rearranges it with ROME.
explanation.definitionFit: A mobster is a member of a criminal gang, particularly the American Mafia.

clue.text: Sting initially had awfully dark times

indicators.note: awfully suggests something badly done, so the gathered letters are thrown into a new order
initially takes just the opening letter of the word had

explanation.surface: The singer Sting had a terrible run of gloomy days.
explanation.walkthrough: 'initially' gives H from 'had', and 'awfully' rearranges STING plus H into the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: The hours of darkness each day are the nights, so dark times is a plain description.

clue.text: Drink with two setters entertaining another in B & B

indicators.note: entertaining means hosting, holding the other letters within

parts.note: a setter refers to themself as I or me, so two give I and ME

indicators.note: in puts the extra letter between the two Bs

parts.note: taken as its two letters
another setter is a further I

explanation.surface: Two crossword setters host a third for a drink at a bed and breakfast.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' puts I between B and B, giving BIB; 'entertaining' puts that inside I + ME.
explanation.definitionFit: To imbibe is to drink, especially alcohol, a straightforward verb synonym.

clue.text: The foreign representative is in a shed changing car parts

indicators.note: in places the foreign article and the politician inside the rearranged letters
changing means the letters of a shed are moved round

parts.note: la is 'the' in French
an MP is a Member of Parliament, an elected representative

explanation.surface: A foreign representative is changing in a garden shed among the car parts.
explanation.walkthrough: 'changing' looks like someone getting dressed in the shed, but it signals the rearrangement; 'in' is the container signal, and 'is' just links.
explanation.definitionFit: Headlamps are the front lights of a car, so they are parts of one.

clue.text: Fragrant sachet not regularly used by little 25?

indicators.note: regularly takes every other letter, starting with the first

parts.note: 25 across is eddy, and the short form of the name Eddy is Ed

explanation.surface: A scented sachet is seldom used by little Eddy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'regularly' takes the odd letters of 'sachet not' (the 'not' is fodder, not a negative), giving SCENT; then ED. 'used by' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Scented means perfumed, having a pleasant smell, the same as fragrant.

clue.text: As I said in 15 27 4 23: "Funny farm? The whole lot are dolts, boss!"

indicators.note: funny means strange, out of order, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: The setter, Puck, likens everyone on a funny farm to fools.
explanation.walkthrough: 15 27 4 23 spells out A MID SUMMER NIGHTS DREAM, the Shakespeare play in which the fairy Puck, the setter's pseudonym, says this line. 'Funny' rearranges the quoted words.
explanation.definitionFit: Puck speaks this famous line in Act 3 of Shakespeare's comedy, scorning the lovers' folly.

clue.text: Part of church services pastor echoed inwardly

indicators.note: echoed means sent back, so the hidden letters are read backwards
inwardly says the letters sit inside the run of the words services pastor

explanation.surface: Church services where the pastor's voice echoes round the building.
explanation.walkthrough: 'inwardly' finds ESPA across 'services pastor', and 'echoed' turns it round.
explanation.definitionFit: An apse is the rounded recess at the east end of a church, usually behind the altar.

clue.text: Bullied ex-PM about pound taking lead from euro

indicators.note: about means around, so the former premier's name wraps the other letters

parts.note: Gordon Brown was UK Prime Minister 2007-10
to pound is to beat

indicators.note: lead from takes the first letter of the word euro

explanation.surface: A former Prime Minister fretting about the pound being led by the euro.
explanation.walkthrough: Gordon Brown was UK prime minister from 2007 to 2010; 'about' is the container signal and 'lead from' the first-letter pick.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone browbeaten has been intimidated by hectoring, which is what being bullied means.

clue.text: Request halves of beer and he'll stay

indicators.note: halves of keeps the front half of each of the three following words

explanation.surface: Someone asks for half a pint of beer and promises to stay on.
explanation.walkthrough: 'halves of' gives BE from 'beer', HE from 'he'll' (four letters, apostrophe aside) and ST from 'stay'.
explanation.definitionFit: At someone's behest means at their request or bidding, so the two nouns are synonyms.

clue.text: God holds detailed account of what's owed for weakness

indicators.note: holds means contains, so the divine word wraps the shortened account

parts.note: a god is a deity

indicators.note: detailed read as de-tailed, the last letter cut off

parts.note: a bill is an account of money owed

explanation.surface: A god keeps a detailed ledger of debts, which seems a weakness.
explanation.walkthrough: 'detailed' looks like 'thorough' but reads as de-tailed, losing its last letter; 'holds' is the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Debility is physical feebleness or frailty, a direct synonym for weakness.

clue.text: Ships moor around similarly shaped items …

indicators.note: around suggests the letters are moved about and reset in a new order

explanation.surface: Vessels tie up all round the harbour, looking much alike.
explanation.walkthrough: 'around' could suggest a container, but nothing fits round anything: it signals the rearrangement. The ellipsis just runs into the next clue.
explanation.definitionFit: In science, isomorphs are things that share the same form or crystal structure.

clue.text: See 8
… amongst the number of nights told of in a diary, originally

indicators.note: in places the Roman number between the other letters
originally takes the opening letter of the word diary

parts.words: the number of nights told of
parts.note: the Thousand and One Nights tells its tales over 1001 nights, MI in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: A diary entry noting how many nights passed, continuing the previous clue.
explanation.walkthrough: MI is 1001, the Arabian Nights count; 'in' puts it between A and D, the first letter of 'diary' ('originally').
explanation.definitionFit: Amid is a preposition meaning in the middle of, exactly the sense of amongst.

clue.text: Animal in 23 (a reptile)

indicators.note: in says the letters lie inside the run of words that follows

parts.note: 23 refers to the answer to 23 down, a dream, written out ahead of the words a reptile

explanation.surface: An animal appearing in a dream, a reptile of some kind.
explanation.walkthrough: Write 23 out as DREAM; the answer is hidden in 'dreAM A REptile', signalled by 'in'.
explanation.definitionFit: A mare is a female horse, so it is one particular kind of animal.

clue.text: Key used after reworking of a half-hearted 27 dance

indicators.note: after means the key letter follows the rearranged letters
reworking means remaking, so the letters are put into a new order
half-hearted removes half of the double letter at the heart of the word

parts.note: 27 refers to the answer to 27 across, summer
E is a musical key

explanation.surface: A summer dance done in a key, reworked half-heartedly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'half-hearted' takes out one of the two middle letters of 27 across; 'reworking of' then rearranges, and the key letter comes 'after'.
explanation.definitionFit: A measure is an old word for a stately dance, as in treading a measure.

clue.text: Hindu deity back in loft reverting to ancestral traits

indicators.note: in places the turned name inside the roof space word

parts.note: a loft is an attic

indicators.note: back means the god's name is written in reverse order

parts.note: Siva (Shiva) is a major Hindu god

explanation.surface: An idol of a Hindu god found in the loft, a throwback to forebears.
explanation.walkthrough: Shiva is also spelt Siva; 'back' reverses the god's name and 'in' tucks it into the roof space.
explanation.definitionFit: Atavistic describes a reversion to ancestral characteristics, a throwback to earlier generations.

clue.text: Vehicle usually starting at university in island republic

parts.note: a van is a vehicle

indicators.note: starting takes the opening letter of the word usually

explanation.surface: A van usually begins its trip at a university on a Pacific island.
explanation.walkthrough: VAN, U from 'usually starting', AT and U for university.
explanation.definitionFit: Vanuatu is an independent Pacific island republic, formerly the New Hebrides.

clue.text: Fashionable drink, as reported by one in the know

indicators.note: as reported signals that the letters are what is heard when the phrase is spoken

parts.note: in means fashionable, and cider is a drink

explanation.surface: A trendy drink is reviewed by an industry expert.
explanation.walkthrough: IN (fashionable) plus CIDER, said aloud, gives the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: An insider is someone within an organisation with privileged information, one who knows.

clue.text: Dull as last character leaving cul-de-sac?

indicators.note: the final letter of the street term is taken away

parts.note: a cul-de-sac is a dead end street

explanation.surface: A cul-de-sac is a dull place once its last resident moves out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'last character leaving' drops the final D from DEAD END.
explanation.definitionFit: To deaden is to dull, as with sound or pain, a verb synonym.

clue.text: City where Java's ore is processed

indicators.note: processed suggests raw material being worked into a different shape

parts.note: taken as written, the s included

explanation.surface: A city where Indonesian ore is refined.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is processed' rearranges JAVAS and ORE into the Bosnian capital.
explanation.definitionFit: Sarajevo is the capital of Bosnia and Herzegovina, a European city.

clue.text: One wearing no undies, divulging super tanning tips?

definitions.text: One wearing no undies, divulging super tanning tips?

indicators.note: wearing means the single letter is clothed by the others, sitting inside them
tips are the front ends of the five words from no to tanning

parts.note: one is I in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: Someone sunbathing without underwear and offering advice on an all-over tan.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tips' gives NUDST from the starts of 'no undies divulging super tanning', and 'wearing' puts I inside. The whole clue also describes a naturist sharing tanning advice.
explanation.definitionFit: A naturist goes without clothes, undies included, and might well share advice on an even tan.

clue.text: Large amount put on wrong 16 across? Singular 4 16 across, maybe

indicators.note: put on means placed on top, so in this down clue D comes first

parts.note: D is 500 in Roman numerals, a large number

indicators.note: wrong means set out incorrectly, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: 16 across is the female horse, mare

explanation.surface: A huge sum bet on the wrong horse feels like a bad night's sleep.
explanation.walkthrough: D is 500 in Roman numerals; 'wrong' rearranges 16 across. 4 and 16 across together make a nightmare, an example of the answer, which explains 'Singular'.
explanation.definitionFit: A nightmare is a frightening dream, so the answer is defined by an example.

clue.text: No time to search trailer before one and all returned for Mexican food

indicators.note: no time means the T is taken out

parts.note: a quest is a search
a trailer is an advertisement for a film, an ad
one is I in Roman numerals

indicators.note: returned means sent back, so the word all is written backwards

explanation.surface: No time to look for a film trailer before everyone goes back for Mexican food.
explanation.walkthrough: A trailer is a film advertisement, hence AD; 'No' removes the time letter and 'returned' reverses only the word all.
explanation.definitionFit: A quesadilla is a Mexican tortilla folded around cheese and grilled, a dish of that cuisine.

clue.text: Reverse current flowing through damaged dynamo

indicators.note: flowing through says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Electricity flowing through a broken generator.
explanation.definitionFit: An eddy is a swirl of water or air running against the main stream, a reverse current.

clue.text: They leave the stage with old tune playing

parts.note: ex is a prefix meaning former or old

indicators.note: playing suggests music performed loosely, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Actors exit as an old tune plays.
explanation.walkthrough: EX for 'old', then 'playing' rearranges TUNE into EUNT.
explanation.definitionFit: Exeunt is the Latin stage direction meaning they go out, used for several actors exiting.

clue.text: When it's warm, start to sunbathe with topless mime artist

indicators.note: start to takes the opening letter of the word sunbathe
topless means the first letter is removed

parts.note: a mummer is an actor in a traditional mime play

explanation.surface: A mime artist strips off to sunbathe once the weather turns warm.
explanation.walkthrough: S from 'start to sunbathe', then 'topless' cuts MUMMER to UMMER. A mummer acts in traditional English folk plays.
explanation.definitionFit: The season of warm weather is summer, the hottest time of year.
